blocks.text: Qualities: nouns from adjectives
-ость — -ness, -ity (used to form abstract nouns from adjectives)
Wiktionary gives -ость one meaning: “-ness, -ity (used to form abstract nouns from adjectives)”. So every word its etymologies build with -ость has it.

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: vivacity, liveliness, animation, vividness, alacrity, sprightliness
peculiarity, feature, characteristic (important or main item)
tenderness, caress, fondness, delicacy; (in the plural) kind words, endearments

blocks.text: Wiktionary, «-ость» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ость#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
-ость — a property
«свойства» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of -ость. Its examples: беременность, благодарность, малость, молодость, торжественность, сложность.

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: smallness, trifle; tiny bit, a little bit; somewhat (also used as an adverb)
youth (state of being young); youth (period in life)

blocks.text: Russian Wiktionary, «-ость», meaning 1 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ость).
-ость — -ness, -ity (used to form abstract nouns from adjectives)

-ness, -ity (used to form abstract nouns from adjectives) — твёрдый (“hard”) + -ость → твёрдость (“hardness”); бе́дный (“poor”) + -ость → бе́дность (“poorness, poverty”); лихо́й (“daring”) + -ость → ли́хость (“bravery, daring”)

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: old age; age, years (as the cause of dilapidation or decrepitude)

blocks.text: Wiktionary, «-ость» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ость#Russian).
-ота — Suffix appended to adjectives to create a feminine noun, usually an abstract noun denoting a quality.

Suffix appended to adjectives to create a feminine noun, usually an abstract noun denoting a quality. — хриплый (“hoarse”) + -ота → хрипота́ (“hoarseness”); красный (“beautiful”) + -ота → красота́ (“beauty”); пусто́й (“empty”) + -ота → пустота́ (“emptiness”)
Wiktionary, «-ота» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ота#Russian).
-от — an abstract feature
«отвлеченного признака или подвижного количественного признака» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of -от. Its examples: чистота, частота.
Russian Wiktionary, «-от», meaning 1 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/-от).
-ств — a property
«свойства» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of -ств. Its examples: равенство.
Russian Wiktionary, «-ств», meaning 1 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ств).
-ин — abstractness
«отвлечённости» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of -ин. Its examples: толщина, седина.

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: gray hair; (figuratively) great age, old age
